reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(so.amount_untaxed), 0) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS order_count FROM sale_order AS so WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(so.amount_untaxed) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT so.id), 0), 0) AS average_order_value FROM sale_order AS so WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year'

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', so.date_order)::date AS month, SUM(so.amount_untaxed) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT rp.name AS customer, SUM(so.amount_untaxed) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so JOIN res_partner AS rp ON rp.id = so.partner_id WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY rp.id, rp.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(pt.name->>'zh_CN', pt.name->>'en_US') AS product, SUM(sol.price_subtotal) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order_line AS sol JOIN sale_order AS so ON so.id = sol.order_id JOIN product_product AS pp ON pp.id = sol.product_id JOIN product_template AS pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND sol.display_type IS NULL AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT rp.name AS salesperson, SUM(so.amount_untaxed) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so JOIN res_users AS ru ON ru.id = so.user_id JOIN res_partner AS rp ON rp.id = ru.partner_id WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY rp.id, rp.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(pt.name->>'zh_CN', pt.name->>'en_US') AS product, SUM(sol.product_uom_qty) AS sales_quantity FROM sale_order_line AS sol JOIN sale_order AS so ON so.id = sol.order_id JOIN product_product AS pp ON pp.id = sol.product_id JOIN product_template AS pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND sol.display_type IS NULL AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY sales_quantity DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(pt.name->>'zh_CN', pt.name->>'en_US') AS product, SUM(sol.product_uom_qty) AS sales_quantity, SUM(sol.qty_delivered) AS delivered_quantity FROM sale_order_line AS sol JOIN sale_order AS so ON so.id = sol.order_id JOIN product_product AS pp ON pp.id = sol.product_id JOIN product_template AS pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND sol.display_type IS NULL AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name

SELECT COALESCE(pt.name->>'zh_CN', pt.name->>'en_US') AS product, SUM(sol.product_uom_qty) AS sales_quantity, SUM(sol.qty_invoiced) AS invoiced_quantity, SUM(sol.product_uom_qty - sol.qty_invoiced) AS uninvoiced_quantity FROM sale_order_line AS sol JOIN sale_order AS so ON so.id = sol.order_id JOIN product_product AS pp ON pp.id = sol.product_id JOIN product_template AS pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND sol.display_type IS NULL AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(so.amount_untaxed), 0) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.date_order)::int AS year, SUM(so.amount_untaxed) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year' AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(so.amount_untaxed), 0) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so JOIN res_partner AS rp ON rp.id = so.partner_id WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND rp.name = 'CODEX Website Customer 20260627' AND so.date_order >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year'

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', so.date_order)::date AS month, SUM(so.amount_untaxed) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= DATE '2099-01-01' AND so.date_order < DATE '2100-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
